result.title: UniCon: Unified Framework for Efficient Contrastive Alignment via Kernels
result.comment: 33 pages, 8 figures, 8 tables. Accepted by The Fourteenth International Conference on Learning Representations (ICLR) 2026
result.summary: Contrastive objectives power state-of-the-art multimodal models, but their training remains slow, relying on long stochastic optimization. We propose a Unified Framework for Efficient Contrastive Alignment via Kernels (UniCon), which spans linear and nonlinear encoders as well as one-to-one and many-to-many alignments. At its core, UniCon introduces the contrastive similarity weight matrix $S(γ)$, which enables closed-form global solutions that provably replace minibatch back-propagation with exact updates. Through the lens of reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces (RKHS), UniCon provides a kernelized perspective that unifies contrastive alignment and reveals its connection to spectral methods. To validate the theory, we conduct experiments on synthetic, unimodal, multimodal, and zero-shot tasks, demonstrating that UniCon achieves substantial efficiency gains while preserving generality and strong empirical performance.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 UniCon 框架，用核方法刻画对比对齐，引入对比相似度权重矩阵 S(γ) 得到闭式全局解，以替代小批量反向传播，并在 RKHS 视角下统一线性/非线性编码器与一对一、多对多对齐，在合成、单模态、多模态和零样本任务上验证效率与性能。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文本身不涉及 latent 视觉推理，但其核化闭式对齐与「用精确更新替代梯度优化」的思路，可能为 VLM 中视觉—文本表示对齐及训练监督的高效实现提供可核查的借鉴线索。
